metadata.title: Create Low-Level Design
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Create a comprehensive LLD document that serves as the technical specification for implementing a user story. Guideline-driven with default fallback.

output.description: Complete LLD document with architecture, data flow, and technical specifications

specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: read context → check guideline → apply guideline/default → create LLD → review completeness → handle gaps → present for approval → process response → update memory
Step is orchestration only - guideline defines the LLD content and structure
If guideline exists: Follow guideline workflow completely
If no guideline: Use default LLD structure as fallback
Revisions after user feedback return to Review completeness (substep 5)

update: memory.json (current step section with LLD path and approval status)

tools: read_file - Read context from memory and previous step outputs
codebase_search - Find relevant patterns and code
bestPractices: Step = orchestration only: handles context, gaps, approval - guideline handles 'how to write'
Always check for guideline before using default structure
Use Q&A session component for information gaps that user can answer
Trigger feedback loop to Step 3 only when deeper analysis is needed
Revisions should always go through Review completeness again

substeps.name: Read context from previous steps
substeps.description: Get user story details, gathered information, and system analysis from memory
actions: Read memory.json for context from Steps 2, 3, 4
Extract user story title, description, acceptance criteria
Get gathered information and system analysis report path

substeps.name: Check for LLD guideline
substeps.description: Look for team's LLD guideline file
actions: Check if .user-processes/guidelines/planning/how-to-write-low-level-design.md exists
If exists: Proceed to substep 3
If not exists: Skip to substep 4 (use default structure)

substeps.name: Apply guideline
substeps.description: Read and apply team's preferred LLD format and sections
actions: Read the guideline file
Extract required sections, diagram types, and format preferences
Note any team-specific requirements or conventions

substeps.name: Create LLD document
substeps.description: Follow guideline to create the LLD document
actions: Follow guideline workflow at .user-processes/guidelines/planning/how-to-write-low-level-design.md
If no guideline exists: Use default structure as fallback
guidelineDefines: Level of detail for each section
How to use context from previous steps

substeps.name: Review completeness
substeps.description: Check all guideline-defined sections and identify information gaps
actions: Review each section for completeness per guideline requirements
Identify any information gaps
Determine if feedback loop needed

substeps.name: Handle information gaps
substeps.description: Gather missing info from user or trigger feedback loop
actions: If gaps can be answered by user: Conduct Q&A session following qa-session.md workflow
If deeper analysis needed: Trigger feedback loop to Step 3 (gather-relevant-information)
Log Q&A session results to log.json
Update memory.json with key answers

substeps.name: Present LLD for approval
substeps.description: Present complete document and wait for user approval
actions: Present LLD document to user
Explain key design decisions
Wait for approval/feedback/rejection

substeps.name: Process approval response
substeps.description: Handle user's response and log interaction
actions: IMMEDIATELY log user interaction before any changes
If approved: Note approval status, proceed to substep 9
If changes requested: Revise LLD, return to substep 5 (Review completeness)
If rejected: Document reason, end step

substeps.name: Update memory
substeps.description: Record LLD path, approval status, key decisions
actions: Update memory.json with LLD document path
Record approval status
Document key design decisions made

flow.description: Context & Setup (1-3) → Create LLD (4) → Review & Gaps (5-6, loops back if Q&A needed) → Approval (7-9, revisions return to Review)

fields: Information Produced: LLD document path, sections included, approval status, key design decisions
Decisions Made: Technical approach, architecture choices
Q&A Session: Questions asked, answers received (if gaps were handled)

defaultLLDStructure.description: Fallback structure when no guideline exists
sections: 1. Overview (User Story Reference, Scope and Objectives, Out of Scope)
2. Current System Analysis (Existing Architecture, Affected Components, Current Data Flow)
3. Proposed Design (Architecture Changes, Component Design, Data Flow)
4. Technical Specifications (API Contracts, Database Changes, Configuration)
5. Diagrams (Class Diagram, Sequence Diagram, Component Diagram)
6. Dependencies and Risks (External Dependencies, Risks and Mitigations)
7. Test Considerations (Key Test Scenarios, Integration Points, Testability Notes)
8. Implementation Notes (Key Decisions, Assumptions, Open Questions)

feedbackLoop.condition: Need more information that requires deeper analysis
feedbackLoop.description: If LLD creation reveals significant information gaps that cannot be answered through Q&A, return to gather more information

requiredFiles: memory.json with context from previous steps
